jobs.description: About the roleAs Process Engineer Lithography, you will be responsible for ensuring stable, capable, and reproducible lithography processes in a high-volume semiconductor manufacturing environment. You will drive process improvements, solve complex technical challenges, support the introduction of new technologies, and work closely with production, maintenance, quality, and development teams to achieve excellence in safety, quality, productivity, and cost performance.This is your new role- Ensure stable, capable, and reproducible lithography processes in daily semiconductor manufacturing operations- Monitor and improve process performance using SPC, process capability indicators, and manufacturing data analysis- Investigate process deviations, non-conforming lots, and yield excursions and drive sustainable corrective actions- Identify process-related quality issues and support continuous yield and defect reduction initiatives- Support root-cause analysis activities using structured problem-solving methodologies such as 5Why and 8D- Define, execute, analyze, and document experiments to improve process capability, productivity, quality, and cost performance- Support qualification, release, and implementation of new processes, materials, and equipment- Contribute to process change management, industrialization projects, and technology transfers into production- Create and maintain process documentation, work instructions, OCAPs, specifications, and training materials- Conduct technical training and knowledge sharing for production teams- Participate in FMEA activities and support risk assessment and mitigation measuresThis is you- University degree in Physics, Chemistry, Electrical Engineering, Materials Science, Microsystems Engineering, or a comparable technical discipline- First professional experience in semiconductor manufacturing, process engineering, or a comparable high-tech production environment is advantageous- Knowledge of lithography processes and semiconductor manufacturing technologies is desirable- Strong analytical thinking skills combined with a structured and systematic working approach- Passion for solving technical problems and driving continuous improvement- Ability to manage multiple tasks and priorities in a dynamic manufacturing environment- Strong communication and teamwork skills- High level of ownership, initiative, and accountability- Practical mindset combined with attention to detail and quality orientation- Good German and English communication skills, both written and spoken

Job DescriptionAs an Equipment Engineer within the EGIO area, you will be responsible for ensuring the technical availability, performance, and continuous improvement of highly complex production equipment used in semiconductor manufacturing. Leveraging your expertise in implantation, epitaxy, glass-processing technologies, and furnace systems, you will play a key role in maintaining stable, quality-compliant, and cost-efficient manufacturing processes while meeting the highest standards of safety, quality, and productivity. Through proactive problem-solving, equipment optimization, and close collaboration with cross-functional teams, you will contribute directly to manufacturing excellence, product quality, and the company's overall competitiveness.You will join a highly skilled and interdisciplinary team of approximately 40 engineers, technicians, and support specialists. Our working environment is built on openness, trust, and collaborative teamwork, providing an atmosphere where technical expertise is valued, innovation is encouraged, and both professional and personal development can thrive.Key ResponsibilitiesEquipment Ownership- Provide technical support, optimization, and further development of production equipment within the EGIO area (Epitaxy, Glass Processes, Implantation, and Furnaces).- Ensure high equipment availability and process stability.- Conduct fault analysis and implement sustainable corrective actions.- Coordinate and oversee preventive maintenance and repair activities.Process and Quality Optimization- Analyze equipment and process data to identify improvement opportunities.- Develop and implement initiatives to improve: - OEE (Overall Equipment Effectiveness)- MTBF (Mean Time Between Failures)- MTTR (Mean Time To Repair)- Process Capability (Cp/Cpk)- Yield and Product Quality- Perform statistical analyses and root-cause investigations.- Support the qualification of new processes, products, and equipment upgrades.Project Management- Lead and participate in cross-functional improvement projects.- Plan and implement equipment upgrades and retrofit programs.- Collaborate with equipment manufacturers, suppliers, and external service providers.- Prepare technical specifications and requirement documents.Production Support- Support escalation management within the manufacturing environment.- Deliver technical training for operators and maintenance technicians.Other Responsibilities- Ensure compliance with safety, environmental, and quality standards.- Maintain equipment performance in line with production targets.- Reduce unplanned equipment downtime.- Document technical modifications and engineering changes.- Support audits and ensure compliance with regulatory and corporate requirements.EducationBachelor’s or Master’s degree in one of the following disciplines:- Electrical/ Mechanical/ Microsystems/Process Engineering- Physics- Materials Science- Or a comparable technical fieldProfessional Experience- Minimum 3 years of experience in the semiconductor industry or a comparable high-tech manufacturing environment.- Practical experience in at least one of the EGIO responsibility areas.Technical Expertise- Strong understanding of semiconductor manufacturing processes.- Knowledge of SPC (Statistical Process Control), FDC (Fault Detection and Classification), APC (Advanced Process Control), and data analytics.- Experience with MES and ERP systems.- Familiarity with vacuum technology, high-temperature processes, gas delivery systems, and cleanroom technologies.- Ability to interpret technical drawings, electrical schematics, and engineering specifications.Personal Competencies- Strong analytical and structured approach to problem-solving.- High level of initiative and ownership.- Ability to work effectively in interdisciplinary teams.- Excellent communication skills across all organizational levels.- Resilience and flexibility in a dynamic manufacturing environment.- Continuous Improvement mindset.Language Skills- Fluent in German and English, both written and spoken.- Ability to communicate effectively with international suppliers and development partners.Reporting Line: Service & Maintenance Managers and the Section Manager.Talent acquisition based on Nexperia vacancies is not appreciated. About NexperiaAt Nexperia, legal expertise is a key enabler of our global business strategy. As a leading international semiconductor company, we operate in a complex, fast-moving environment where high quality legal advice truly matters. We are looking for an experienced Senior Legal Counsel who combines strong corporate and M&A expertise with business acumen and a collaborative mindset.About the roleIn this senior role you:- Provide corporate legal support and ensure corporate compliance for the global Nexperia group, including Nexperia Germany and the Hamburg site (which includes corporate housekeeping and ESG).- Act as secretary to the Nexperia Germany Board of Directors.- Support the Deputy Chief Legal Officer ("DCLO") on specific matters in strategic corporate projects, such as in the field of Corporate/M&A, Finance, Tax and Treasury (which includes M&A, investments, strategic co-operations (incl R&D), intercompany agreements, treasury and insurance matters).- Deliver commercial legal support to certain key customers under the supervision of the DCLO.- Are managing disputes, litigation and claims (such as distributors, local suppliers etc).- Are managing outside legal counsel and legal spend.- Support the German Corporate Affairs department.The role is based at our office in Hamburg, and you will report directly to the Deputy Chief Legal Officer.What you will needThe ideal candidate has 6-10 years of relevant experience as a corporate lawyer or (in-house) legal counsel and is ready to further apply and deepen their expertise in an international environment.Furthermore, you have:- A completed university degree in law.- A truly international mindset and have excellent communication skills in English (written and verbal).- Strong knowledge of and experience in corporate law and ESG in an international setting.- Relevant experience gained at a leading law firm and/or a multinational company (considered as an advantage).- M&A experience (considered a strong advantage).- Experience working closely with Finance, Treasury and/or Tax departments.- Litigation experience (considered an advantage).- Proven experience working with C‑suite and senior management stakeholders.

jobs.description: About UsReady to rock the future with us? At Hellmann we put our people at the heart of everything we do, because for us, relationship matters. Joining us does not just mean becoming part of a global company. It is an invitation to shape the future of the logistics industry together with us. Our Hellmann culture is based on our four values: Caring, Entrepreneurial, Forward-Thinking and Reliable. These values resonate with yours? Then become part of our FAMILY that consists of around 10.000 employees in more than 200 locations worldwide. For the better. Together.  As a member of our sea freight automotive team, you are part of the most successful sea freight product in our company. We manage shipments from the supplier to the end customer and maintain very close cooperation with our customers.The logistics industry is currently very challenging, as it is everywhere - but with us you will find a team that sticks together and masters the challenges together. Our operational colleagues at the Ratingen site will be delighted if you become a member of our Hellmann family.About the job* You are responsible for sea freight handling (FCL and LCL) in the automotive sector* You will be responsible for order acceptance and independent processing including invoicing of orders* You will prepare all necessary documents using our in-house processing software* Direct and trusting communication with our foreign companies and customers is also part of your tasksAbout you* You have successfully completed your training in the field of forwarding/logistics* You have first relevant professional experience in the field of sea freight export or comparable qualifications in transportation/logistics* Fluent German and good written and spoken English skills* You are comfortable working with MS Office 365* The ability to solve problems and act systematically, a resolute way of working, the ability to work in a team and customer orientation round off your profileAbout our benefits* Hellmann Spirit: “You” culture throughout the company, regular team and company events, birthday lottery ticket from the German TV lottery* Work-life integration: 39 hours/week, working time recording and home office option* Additional financial benefits: Vacation and Christmas bonus, company pension scheme and capital-forming benefits, up to €1,600 net bonus for recommending new colleagues, discounts and offers for travel, leisure and culture* Health & well-being: Mental health and health coaching, changing dishes in our canteen* Family: days off to care for relatives and for special events* Professional & personal development: Newcomer Days, further education and training opportunities through our Academy, digital learning platform* Mobility: mobility allowanceInclusion and social diversity are firmly anchored values in our corporate culture. Regardless of gender, age, any disabilities, religion, ethnic origin or sexual identity: We are looking forward to meeting you!If you are excited by this fantastic opportunity and have what it takes, then click APPLY!Any open questions? You contribute functional and technical expertise across case management, customer interactions, knowledge, entitlements, service channels, automation, data quality, reporting, and related integrations.Your responsibilitiesBusiness Analysis and Requirements Engineering- Plan, facilitate, and document workshops, interviews, process mapping, and refinement sessions with global and local Customer Service stakeholders;
